message.text: Checking whether UpdateMemo broadcasts via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. Also verifying if SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations broadcast through the same mechanism.

Direct memo handlers broadcasting live events are CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction. UpdateMemo broadcasts indirectly through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations may also broadcast live events. Their exact RPC handler names still need confirmation.

SSE (Server-Sent Events) is the mechanism. The hub is implemented in server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. HTTP registration happens in sse_handler.go. The CreateMemo handler broadcasts through it.

UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction also broadcast through the SSE hub.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The browser live channel is Server-Sent Events. `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` fans events out; `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` exposes the stream. `CreateMemo` and `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`) and `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go`) call `SSEHub.Broadcast` directly. `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, and `SetMemoRelations` go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go`. `UpsertMemoReaction` and `DeleteMemoReaction` in `reaction_service.go` broadcast reaction events.
